current.note: Square 1254 x 1254 PNG masters, re-shot/re-rendered by the client to replace the low-resolution extracts previously pulled from the printed PDF. Converted to WebP with cwebp -q 82..86; the PNG masters are not tracked here.
current.medallion_fit: The medallion crops each square to its inscribed circle and then lays an inner vignette over the outer rim, so the dish has to stay inside roughly 0.90 of the frame radius. Measured across this set the dish reaches 0.72-0.90 of the radius; anything at or above 1.0 is clipped.

exports.note: Re-exported 2026-08-08 with breathing room. As delivered, the boat lay corner to corner and reached 1.012 of the frame radius, so the circular medallion sliced off its lower-right tip on both the menu and the site's carta strip. The framing is unchanged apart from scale: the master was scaled to 0.85 about its centre and the surrounding dark ground extended to the original edge (magick -virtual-pixel edge -distort SRT '0.85 0'), putting the dish at 0.86 of the radius, level with manti.webp. Nothing was retouched, recoloured, or recomposed.
